tasks.query: A test-cache write should downgrade operating-system failures raised while writing or closing a buffered cache file to the same warning used for open failures, rather than failing the test.

When a temporary mutation helper cannot delete an attribute or modify a read-only mapping, it must not record an undo operation for a change that never succeeded, otherwise fixture teardown can raise a second spurious error.
Collecting a parent directory more than once in one command should not create distinct directory identities that make previously registered fixtures disappear from a later test's fixture closure.

Formatting valid Python with skip directives on both ends of a parenthesized compound-statement header should preserve a parseable header instead of separating the closing parenthesis from its structural colon.
An inline comment following the closing parenthesis of an expression that also contains own-line comments must remain after the closing parenthesis instead of being moved inside the expression.

A long quoted return annotation should be split to respect the configured line length even when the function has parameters, matching the formatting already used for the same annotation on a parameterless function.
Importing the test client with current AnyIO should not emit a deprecation warning because it references an obsolete blocking-portal alias; the supported portal type should be used consistently.

The backward-compatible positional form of a template response should read optional headers, media type, and background arguments from their own positions rather than reusing one index and mis-parsing or raising on valid calls.
The per-part size limit used while parsing multipart form data should be configurable by callers so an application can intentionally accept an individual part larger than the built-in default.

On Python 3.14, a class-variable annotation represented as a forward reference because its import only occurs during type checking should still be recognized as a class variable and excluded from the generated initializer.

A field-transformation callback should receive attributes whose default aliases have already been resolved, including automatically stripping a leading underscore, rather than seeing missing aliases that appear only after class creation.
A field transformer implemented as a generator should have its yielded field changes applied just like a list-returning transformer, so subclasses retain the intended initializer keyword behavior.
Setting a base URL with an explicit trailing slash must preserve that slash, so an empty relative request does not silently target the slashless URL.

A streaming multipart upload must not race on cancellation state or hang waiting for its producer after the server has already returned a response; a closable source should be interrupted safely during shutdown.
Explicitly configuring both the minimum and maximum retry wait to zero should represent a constant zero delay instead of silently replacing those values with the library defaults.
Mutably downcasting an error through a context chain must not create a mutable reference by passing through a shared reference, because that violates Rust aliasing rules and is rejected by Miri.
An error-checking macro should compile a boolean expression containing an unparenthesized subtraction after a logical OR exactly as it compiles the equivalent expression with explicit parentheses.
Temporaries created inside an error-construction expression should be dropped before a following await point so they do not make an otherwise shareable future fail the Sync bound.
